text: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
Sharks existed before trees did, and their skeletons are made of cartilage.
Your bones are constantly broken down and rebuilt throughout your life.
The human nose can detect over a trillion distinct scents.
A day on Venus lasts longer than its year.
Some whales can live for over two centuries, carrying harpoons from the 1800s in their blubber.
Botanically, bananas are berries, while strawberries are not true berries.
A typical cumulus cloud weighs about as much as a hundred elephants.
Your stomach lining replaces itself every few days, otherwise it would digest itself.
